Both sides draw from Civil War-era origins—KU celebrating abolitionists, Mizzou their Union-protecting militia—turning old border raids into modern trash talk ahead of the game at David Booth Kansas Memorial Stadium.

news.summary: A graphic lists franchises like the Steelers, Jaguars, Seahawks, and Texans that have never won key Associated Press awards such as MVP, Comeback Player of the Year, or Rookie honors. Steelers fans joked about their 300-year wait for an Offensive Player of the Year despite their legacy, while Seahawks supporters vented over overlooked rookies like Kenneth Walker and Jaxon Smith-Njigba. Texans fans recalled close calls for J.J. Watt's MVP bids and C.J. Stroud's rookie honors, and Jaguars backers pointed to their Walter Payton Man of the Year as a bright spot. The lists fuel chats about voter choices, team droughts, and hopes for breaking through.

news.hook: Jets fans marked 246 days since their last game week, ready to face former coach Robert Saleh now leading the Titans in Nashville.
news.name: Jets Face Ex-Coach Saleh's Titans in NFL Season Opener
news.summary: The New York Jets kick off the 2026 NFL season Sunday against the Tennessee Titans at 1 p.m. ET on CBS and Paramount+, with Saleh making his Titans debut against his old team. The Jets, under second-year coach Aaron Glenn and quarterback Geno Smith after a 3-14 season, meet a young Titans squad with second-year QB Cam Ward following back-to-back poor years. Fans trade bold predictions, from Jets hopefuls eyeing a strong start to Titans backers touting their home 'Ring of Fire' edge.

news.hook: With the Seahawks hosting the Patriots in a Super Bowl rematch to open the 2026 season, early power rankings have fans fired up over their favorite teams' spots.
news.name: Week 1 NFL Power Rankings Put Seahawks and Rams on Top
news.summary: Multiple outlets like Pro Football Talk, FOX Sports, and Richard Sherman rank the defending champion Seahawks No. 1 and Rams No. 2, crediting LA's superteam vibe from adding Myles Garrett and Aaron Donald's return. Texans, Broncos, and Bills fill out most top fives, though lists vary with Bears, Patriots, and Ravens sparking fan pushback like calls of 'crazy work' for ranking them over Buffalo. These rankings kick off debates as key Week 1 matchups, including Rams vs. 49ers in Australia, loom large.

news.hook: Patrick Paul respects Maxx Crosby's fire but plans to rattle him with trash talk and physical play. It's classic bulletin board material as the teams gear up for Sunday.
news.name: Dolphins Tackle Calls Raiders' Crosby a Hothead Ahead of Opener
news.summary: Miami Dolphins left tackle Patrick Paul labeled Las Vegas Raiders edge rusher Maxx Crosby a hothead during a Monday press conference, saying the key to stopping him is getting under his skin to disrupt his rhythm. Paul noted that once Crosby is off his game, it's easier to handle, drawing from a successful 2024 tactic where a teammate drew a penalty on him. Crosby, already motivated after a failed trade and eager to prove his elite status, now has extra fuel heading into the September 13 clash at Allegiant Stadium. Fans see the remarks as prime motivation for Crosby to unleash sacks.

news.hook: Vikings fans predict a 30-point rout, listing Packers' defensive woes and Jordan Love as reasons. Packers supporters fire back with injury context and jabs at Minnesota's QB shuffle.
news.name: Vikings-Packers Fans Clash Online Before NFC North Opener
news.summary: Ahead of Sunday's NFC North clash at U.S. Bank Stadium, Vikings backers mock Green Bay's new defensive coordinator Jonathan Gannon, weak lines, no running backs, and QB Jordan Love. Packers fans counter by noting absences like Micah Parsons on PUP and Josh Jacobs on exempt list, plus Minnesota's switch from a benched top pick to Kyler Murray under Kevin O’Connell. The heated exchange, fueled by memes, highlights the fierce rivalry as the 4:25 p.m. ET CBS game nears, with Vikings slight home favorites.

news.name: NFL Fans Share Bold Super Bowl LXI Predictions as 2026 Season Starts
news.summary: As Super Bowl LXI approaches at SoFi Stadium in Los Angeles on February 14, 2027, fans and analysts are posting playoff forecasts, division breakdowns, and bold picks like the Titans or Bears. Good Morning Football's Kyle Brandt drew cheers and debates with his bracket reveal, while experts from Sporting News see the Buffalo Bills beating the Chicago Bears in the big game. BBC Sport contributors back strong runs by the Rams or Bills, and graphics circulate projecting Broncos or Rams lifting the Lombardi Trophy. The predictions face their first test Wednesday when the defending champion Seahawks host the Patriots.

news.name: Fantasy Football Draft Excitement Builds Ahead of NFL Season
news.summary: As the 2026 NFL regular season nears, with the Seahawks hosting the Patriots in a Super Bowl rematch on September 9, fantasy managers are posting their ESPN app teams for feedback and review. First-timers mix stars like Saquon Barkley and Patrick Mahomes with sleepers, while veterans juggle mock drafts and overlapping picks amid jokes about chaos—like a waving squirrel meme. ESPN's role as the official fantasy game adds to the buzz, blending strategy, excitement, and friendly rivalries just before Week 1.

news.hook: A grocery bin packed with orange-and-blue BuzzBallz under the leaping Dolphins logo caught fans off guard. One summed it up perfectly: 'Oh shit. Bout to make some bad decisions.'
news.name: Dolphins Fans Joke Over BuzzBallz Display Amid Team Struggles
news.summary: The photo shows rows of 15% ABV BuzzBallz canned cocktails in team colors stocked at what looks like a big-box store, right under the Miami Dolphins emblem. Fans tied it to the team's rough early 2026 start, with jokes like 'the irony of a dolphins themed buzz ball' and 'drinking one and you make the team.' Playful replies compared supporting the Dolphins to making worst-life decisions, turning a simple store display into shared humor for passionate supporters.
